id: # Every clue written in other words where MiniLM's number one (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 180-word passages, best passage) is the
# wrong page (45 of 61), read by us on 20 October 2026. The same for mxbai-embed-large-v1: week7_meaning_misses_mxbai.tsv.
# Labels: story = the passage is about the right character's story, on someone else's page;
#         lookalike = a different character who shares at least two of the clue's facts;
#         word = one word or phrase of the clue taken literally (a pun, a homonym);
#         theme = shares one theme with the clue and nothing specific;
#         noise = nothing we could connect to the clue.
# The labels are our reading of the passage MiniLM matched (the game now plays mxbai and shows its passages instead);
# scripts/analyse_week7.py checks them against the ranking and counts them.
